investigation_notes.Description: An unusually high volume of SharePoint downloads was observed for user Linas.Pavilionis@globalcorp.ee, totaling 840 files, far above the 24-hour baseline of 4. The activity originated from Vilnius, Lithuania at 21:30 UTC (about 23:30 local), occurring outside typical business hours. The download list includes several sensitive documents, and the destination IP appears to point to an external endpoint; these factors collectively raise the potential for data exfiltration and warrant further investigation.
